description: Verifies every camera navigation mode of the engine: mode catalogue and command-queue selection, free-fly translation and rotation limits, orientation basis, rocket-mode integration under pause, clamp and non-finite conditions, pose preservation across mode switches, and the interactive controller snap, look-at and surface-walk helpers.

checks.label: the engine exposes exactly six navigation modes
Planet Orbit is navigation mode 5
mode 0 (Free Fly 6-DOF) can be selected through the command queue
mode 1 (Orbit Center) can be selected through the command queue
mode 2 (Spherical) can be selected through the command queue
mode 3 (Rocket 6-DOF Thrust) can be selected through the command queue
mode 4 (Surface Walk) can be selected through the command queue
mode 5 (Planet Orbit) can be selected through the command queue
cycling with the interface formula visits every mode and wraps to the first
finite translation is accepted
translation updates x
translation updates y
translation updates z
spherical radius is synchronised after translation
spherical polar angle is synchronised after translation
spherical azimuth is synchronised after translation
non-finite translation is rejected and leaves the camera untouched
positive translation is clamped to the position limit
negative translation is clamped to the position limit
pitch is clamped to 89 degrees
yaw and roll are wrapped to a half turn
negative pitch is clamped to -89 degrees
non-finite rotation is rejected
field of view is clamped to 175 degrees
field of view is clamped to 5 degrees
navigation speed keeps a positive minimum
forward, right and up form an orthonormal frame for every sampled attitude
the frame keeps a constant handedness for every sampled attitude
